
'''Yamada Shrine''' (山田神社) refers to various [[Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]] located across Japan.

* '''Kanagawa Prefecture'''
** [[Yamada Shrine (Yokohama City)]] - Located in Minamiyamada Town, [[Tsuzuki-ku, Yokohama|Tsuzuki Ward]], Yokohama City. A shrine designated for offerings and former village shrine.

* '''Osaka Prefecture'''
** [[Yamada Shrine (Hirataka)]] - Located in Yamanoue, [[Hirakata|Hirakata City]]. A former village shrine.
** [[Yamada Shrine]] - Located in Taguchi, Hirakata City. A former village shrine.

* '''Yamaguchi Prefecture'''
** [[Yamada Shrine (Yamaguchi City)]] - Located in Ato Jifuku Kami, [[Yamaguchi (city)|Yamaguchi City]].
** '''Yamada Shrine (Suō Province)''' - A shrine listed in the historical records of Suō Province.
*** [[Yamada Shrine (Suō-Ōshima Town)]] - Located in Sotoiri, Suō-Ōshima Town, Ōshima District, Yamaguchi Prefecture. A candidate for the above shrine.
*** [[Yamada Shrine (Shikano Town)]] - Previously located in Shikano Town, now part of Shunan City, Yamaguchi Prefecture. Referred to as [[Nisho Yamada Shrine]].

* '''Kagawa Prefecture'''
** [[Yamada Shrine (Kanonji City)]] - Located in Kuda Town, [[Kan'onji, Kagawa|Kanonji City]]. A former village shrine and a [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Shikinaisha]].
